subcommand.description: The uftrace sub-command to execute (e.g., record, replay, live, report, graph).

command.description: The command or binary to trace.

data_dir.description: Directory to store or read trace data.

debug_domains.description: Comma-separated list of debug domains to enable (e.g., uftrace,symbol). Use empty list for default behavior.

color.description: Enable/disable color output. Values: yes, no, auto.

no_pager.description: Do not use a pager for output.

filter.description: List of function names to trace (whitelist). Use empty list for no filtering.

hide.description: List of function names to hide from trace output (blacklist). Use empty list for no hiding.

depth.description: Trace functions within this depth. 0 means unlimited.

max_stack.description: Set maximum stack depth for tracing.

flat.description: Use flat output format instead of tree/recursive.

auto_args.description: Automatically show arguments and return values for known functions.

show_retval.description: Show return values for traced functions.

output_format.description: Output format style. Values: normal, html.

sort_keys.description: Sort keys for report output (e.g., self, total, calls). Use empty list for default sort.

kernel_trace.description: Enable tracing of kernel functions as well.

kernel_depth.description: Trace kernel functions within this depth.

libmcount_path.description: Load libmcount libraries from this custom path.

demangle.description: C++ symbol demangling style. Values: full, simple, no.

match_type.description: Pattern matching type for filters. Values: regex, glob.

time_filter.description: Hide functions running less than this time (e.g., 1ms).

size_filter.description: Apply dynamic patching for functions bigger than this size (e.g., 100B).
